name: Cryptocurrency Color Icons
about: Cryptocurrency Color Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 483 icons designed by Christopher Downer. Covers popular cryptocurrencies and payment symbols for fintech apps and dashboards. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC0 1.0.

faqs.q: Are Cryptocurrency Color Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 483 Cryptocurrency Color Icons are open source under the CC0 1.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC0 1.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: Which coins do Cryptocurrency Color Icons cover?
faqs.a: Popular cryptocurrencies and payment symbols for fintech apps and dashboards. Search a coin or token name above to check that it's included.

faqs.q: How do I use Cryptocurrency Color Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Cryptocurrency Color Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 483 icons in the Cryptocurrency Color Icons set, designed by Christopher Downer. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Cryptocurrency Color Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
